decisions.statement: A row names the mechanic that ran rather than the rules that were in force.
A row holds what the mechanic was handed, so running it again answers the same.
A row carried over from an older shape has no row before it to follow.
No row holds a copy of the rules, the commit holding those.
A row written before a command ran holds the game master's shape, not the mechanic's.

definition: every mechanic a game has run, what it was handed and what it answered
